patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: The other driver was texting — I want that noted. I'm mostly fine, it's my back that's being dramatic, not me. And no, I am not putting on one of those paper gowns.
clinical.presentationShort: 61yo F — back pain s/p MVC, midline tenderness, moving both legs.
clinical.presentationLong: 61-year-old female, lower back pain after a motor-vehicle collision, midline tenderness, moving both legs.

diagnosis.primary: Post-MVC back pain in an older adult — rule out vertebral (compression) fracture / spinal injury
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → trauma-informed exam, spinal imaging (CT for fracture), analgesia, serial neuro checks; not a simple strain given mechanism + age
diagnosis.why: Nice — back pain after a crash in a 60-something isn't a muscle strain until imaging says so. Mechanism + osteoporosis risk = image the spine. 🎯
diagnosis.redFlag: MVC mechanism + age >60 → occult vertebral fracture risk; 'just back pain' after trauma isn't Fast Track

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: well-dressed woman about 60, smart blouse and slacks, tasteful jewelry, hair neatly done
aiImageGeneration.pose: standing beside the clinic chair, leaning forward, one hand gripping the edge of the chair for support
aiImageGeneration.expression: face tight with pain, dignified but clearly hurting
signs: antalgic posture — bent forward, bracing on the chair
other hand pressed to her lower back
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: alert and composed, but in real pain and unable to sit comfortably
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a well-dressed Hispanic woman about 60 in a smart blouse and slacks with tasteful jewelry and neat hair, standing beside a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: standing beside the chair, leaning forward, one hand gripping the chair edge for support, the other pressed to her lower back. Expression: only mildly uncomfortable, a slight wince, dignified and composed (NOT in agony, NOT crying). Clearly visible: an antalgic bent-forward posture bracing on the chair. Overall alert, composed, and only moderately uncomfortable - a stiff sore back, not a crisis. No text, no logos.
